name: WinWay Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: WinWay Technology Co., Ltd. designs, processes, and sells optoelectronic product test fixtures, integrated circuit test interfaces, and fixtures and their components in Taiwan, the Americas, China, Asia, Europe, and Canada. Its products include test sockets, HyperSocket, coaxial sockets, burn-in sockets, PoP sockets, and CRS sockets; heatsink and manual lid; vertical and WLCSP probe cards; i-Bump interposers; and thermal control products, including ATC, E-Flux 4.0, HEATCon Titan, and chiller, as well as changeover kit and plunger products.
